purpose: Assess whether a historical Binance USD-M universe can be upgraded from archival data availability to point-in-time trading eligibility for Alpha 015 or any broad cross-sectional candidate.

findings.finding: Binance Vision provides dated futures market-data files and integrity checksums, but its public symbol-discovery helper queries the current exchangeInfo endpoint.
findings.use: Supports historical price/volume availability and file integrity, not dated eligibility.

findings.finding: Binance Developer Community states that historical snapshots of the futures exchangeInfo endpoint are not available and advises users to capture them prospectively.
findings.use: Rules out treating current or reconstructed exchangeInfo as contemporaneous contract status.

findings.finding: A third-party availability tracker can derive daily symbol-file availability and volume from Binance Vision archives.
findings.use: Useful descriptive diagnostic only; a present archive file does not prove contract status, listing constraints, or decision-time eligibility.

allowed_next_actions: retain the existing archive as diagnostic-only with its file checksums and next-open execution coverage
continue prospective append-only universe capture until the preregistered 180-day criterion is reached
evaluate an external dated contract-status vendor only after its historical publication-time and revision rules are independently documented
forbidden_shortcuts: using today's exchangeInfo as an historical membership list
equating a Vision data file with eligible contract status
opening Alpha 015 on a survivorship-selected current-symbol panel
